submission.machine_card: Electric heater, positive gain, self-draining to ambient ~0.05. DC gain K~1.0-1.02 (yss~0.05+1.014*u). Dominant lag tau~155-160s, delay <10s. No dead-zone below 0.4. Hold for target 0.5 is u~0.44-0.45 (measured: u=0.44 trending to ~0.496, u=0.48 trending to ~0.537, y=0.497 at end of E6). Heating 0.05->0.395 in 180s at u=0.5, slope still +0.0014/s after 300s; cooling 0.486->0.19 in 180s at u=0, slope -0.0012/s. Sensor quantization ~0.005, noise <0.01 vs band width 0.05. Response direction up with u, slow, monotonic, no overshoot, loses heat on its own.
submission.design_rationale: First-order self-draining heater: dy/dt=(0.05+K*u-y)/tau with K~1.01, tau~158s from E1-E6 fits (cooling 0.486->0.19 in 180s gives tau~158s; heating 0.05->0.395 in 180s at u=0.5 gives yss~0.557; E5 u=0.44->0.454 trending to 0.496 and E6 u=0.48->0.497 trending to 0.537 confirm). Hold for 0.5 is (0.5-0.05)/1.014=0.444. Use feedforward 0.444 + PI to trim residual. Kp=1.5 gives ~max power from cold for fast rise (~90s to band) but ~hold at target so no momentum overshoot (first-order). Ki=0.012 (Ti=125s~tau) trims FF error. Integral enabled only |e|<0.15 and when not driving deeper into saturation, clamped +-0.25 to leave >0.2 authority for FF error while preventing windup during 100-200s heat-up. 6s low-pass on y rejects 0.005 quantization without adding lag vs 158s plant. Safety clamp to [0,1] and force 0 above 0.85.
submission.predicted_behavior: From cold (~0.05) full power ~1.0 for ~85s, enters band [0.475,0.525] in ~85-100s, crosses 0.5 in ~95s, overshoot <0.02 and stays in band. From near target settles in ~60-120s. Steady-state u~0.44-0.48 depending on true gain, y~0.5+-0.01. After 300s settling, MAE <0.01 and time-in-band >95% with minimal energy (u^2 ~0.2).
self_test_expectations: control returns finite float in [0,1] for y in [0,1], target 0.5, dt 0.2-3s
first call with {} does not raise and initializes filtered measurement
large positive error (y=0.05) gives u near 1.0 (max heat)
small error (y=0.5) gives u near 0.44 +-0.1 (feedforward hold)
negative error (y=0.7) gives u well below hold, decreasing with y
sustained offset (y=0.46) integrates upward over 100 steps
quantization steps of 0.005 do not cause u chatter >0.05
submission.operator_note: Controller holds ~0.44 power plus small trim to keep 0.5 C-normalized. Heats at full power from cold, then backs off automatically. Stays well below 0.85 soft limit. No action needed; do not add manual heat.
